description: Valid IDN-RT / IDN-Stream channel messages, layouts, channel/SDM boundaries

Stream.publisher: International Laser Display Association (ILDA), Technical Committee

Hello.publisher: International Laser Display Association (ILDA), Technical Committee

fixtures.summary: Empty RT channel message packet (establish / keep link)

expect.effect: establish connection or reset link timeout

fixtures.summary: Routing-only Void message: open channel 0, service 1, mode 0x01, 8-octet XYRGBI dictionary
First data message: routing + XYRGBI dictionary + 20 wave samples (service 0 = default)

segments.value: X=256 Y=-256 R=0xFF G=0x80 B=0x00 I=0xFF
X=512 Y=-512 R=0xFF G=0x80 B=0x00 I=0xFF
X=768 Y=-768 R=0xFF G=0x80 B=0x00 I=0xFF

expect.decoded_note: x/y are signed 16-bit (high octet + precision octet); colors and intensity are the raw 8-bit octets
expect.datagram_note: 36 overhead octets + 20 x 8 sample octets = 196; message total size 192 (0x00C0)

fixtures.summary: As rt-first-config-wave-xyrgbi-20 but routed to explicit service 1

segments.value: X=256 Y=-256 R=0xFF G=0x80 B=0x00 I=0xFF
X=512 Y=-512 R=0xFF G=0x80 B=0x00 I=0xFF
X=768 Y=-768 R=0xFF G=0x80 B=0x00 I=0xFF

expect.decoded_note: x/y are signed 16-bit (high octet + precision octet); colors and intensity are the raw 8-bit octets

fixtures.summary: Second data message: no configuration, samples 20..39, timestamp continues

expect.decoded_note: x/y are signed 16-bit (high octet + precision octet); colors and intensity are the raw 8-bit octets
expect.requires: rt-first-config-wave-xyrgbi-20 processed first on the same connection

fixtures.summary: Void message with Close bit: close channel 0 (no routing, SCWC/service/mode 0)
Graceful connection close, empty payload, on the established link

expect.effect: finish output, close channels, close connection
expect.precondition: connection established; otherwise empty close is not allowed (0xEB when ACK requested)

fixtures.summary: Graceful close with ACK request, empty payload

segments.value: 0x45 RT graceful close with ACK request

fixtures.summary: Abort: reset session immediately, no payload

expect.effect: abort output, reset channels, close connection

fixtures.summary: Standard IDTF XYRGB layout (7-octet sample, Void tag aligns dictionary)
Reordered colors: Blue, Green, Red octet order
refs: Stream 3.4 p15 (descriptor order matches octet order)

expect.decoded_note: 8-bit coordinates are left aligned signed values (Stream 3.4.7)

fixtures.summary: NOP descriptor consumes an ignored octet
Hint format 0 with color scale 1 (colors divided by 4)

refs: Stream 2.1 p8 (all 64 channel IDs SHALL be supported)

fixtures.summary: Routing with SDM=1 and matching SCM=1 in the same message
Routing with SDM=2 and matching SCM=2 in the same message
Routing with SDM=3 and matching SCM=3 in the same message
SDM=1 in configuration but SCM=2 in the wave chunk of the same message

expect.effect: discard service configuration, void channel, wait for new configuration
